profile.distinguishingDetail: A shirt made without collar stays relies entirely on the quality of its interlining and construction to maintain the shape and stiffness of the collar points. This is standard on soft, unstructured collars — particularly Neapolitan-style shirts — where the collar is designed to drape naturally rather than project rigidly. The result is a lived-in, un-fussed collar posture that is intrinsic to sprezzatura dressing.
